description: Reorders inverted temporal clauses (e.g. 'Before X, do Y') into chronological execution sequence.
Formats multi-action instructions into numbered atomic steps (1. Step one. 2. Step two.).
Preserves safety-critical and task-critical modifiers on their associated action nodes.
Converts passive voice with explicit agent into active voice.
Unpacks abstract nominalizations into simple direct verbs (e.g. 'make a choice' -> 'choose').
Splits long compound and coordinated sentences at safe conjunction boundaries.
Re-inserts explicit grammatical subject in split coordinated clauses.
Substitutes words exceeding target-age complexity using governed lexicon and allowlisted equivalents.
Repairs verb tense, subject-verb agreement, and determiners after lexical substitution.
Attaches governed child-friendly definitions and contextual examples for complex domain words.
